1.1.explain: Ingliz tilida salomlashib, ismingizni ayting va nima sababdan kelganingizni bildiring. I bilan am, you bilan are ishlatiladi: I am = I’m, you are = you’re. Kasb safarida on business, dam olishda on holiday, o‘qish uchun to study deyiladi.
examples: Hello, I’m Dilshod. — Salom, men Dilshodman.
I’m here to study. Are you here on holiday? — Men bu yerga o‘qish uchun keldim. Siz ta’tildamisiz?
1.1.try: O‘zingizni tanishtirib, safar maqsadingiz haqida 2 gap yozing. Keyin sherigingizdan Are you here on business? deb so‘rang.

1.2.explain: Qayerdan ekaningizni aytish uchun I’m from + mamlakat/shahar ishlating. Savol: Where are you from? Shaharni aniqlashtirish uchun Where in ...? deyiladi. Mamlakat nomlari bosh harf bilan yoziladi; 1–10 sonlarini aytishni ham mashq qiling.
examples: Where are you from? — I’m from Brazil. — Qayerdansiz? — Braziliyadanman.
Where in Brazil? — São Paulo. — Braziliyaning qayeridan? — San-Pauludan.
1.2.try: Bir mamlakat va shahar tanlang. Sherigingiz bilan Where are you from? / Where in ...? savol-javobini 3 marta, mamlakatni almashtirib mashq qiling.

1.3.explain: Ism va familiyani ingliz harflari nomi bilan birma-bir ayting. Savol so‘zlari savol boshida keladi: What — nima/qaysi, Where — qayer, How — qanday. Telefon raqamida 0 ni oh (‘ou’) deyish mumkin; bir xil ikki raqam double eight kabi aytiladi.
examples: What’s your name? — My name’s Ali. — Ismingiz nima? — Ismim Ali.
How do you spell that? — A-L-I. What’s your phone number? — 90-... — Qanday harflanadi? — A-L-I. Telefon raqamingiz nima?
1.3.try: Ismingiz va familiyangizni inglizcha harflab yozing. Keyin What’s your name? va How do you spell that? savollariga o‘zingiz javob bering.

1.4.explain: Tanishuvdan keyin xayrlashishni va mehmonxona ro‘yxat varag‘ini to‘ldirishni o‘rganasiz. Ism, shahar va mamlakat bosh harf bilan yoziladi. Formadagi reason for visit — tashrif maqsadi; signature — imzo. Have a nice day deganga Thanks, you too deb javob bering.
examples: Good morning. How are you? — Fine, thanks. And you? — Xayrli tong. Qalaysiz? — Yaxshi, rahmat. Siz-chi?
Have a nice day. — Thanks. You too. — Kuningiz yaxshi o‘tsin. — Rahmat, sizniki ham.
1.4.try: O‘zingiz haqingizdagi ism, familiya, mamlakat va tashrif sababini formaga yozing; sherigingiz bilan tekshiring.

2.1.explain: Yaqindagi bitta buyum — this, uzoqdagi bitta buyum — that. Yaqindagi ko‘plik — these, uzoqdagi ko‘plik — those. Birlikda a/an, ko‘plikda odatda -s qo‘shiladi: a key, two keys. Buyum nomini ko‘rsatib yoki atrofga qarab ayting.
examples: What’s this? — It’s a key. — Bu nima? — Kalit.
Those are phones. — Ana ular telefonlar.
2.1.try: Atrofingizdan 2 ta yaqin va 2 ta uzoq buyumni tanlab, this/that/these/those bilan inglizcha ayting.

2.2.explain: Odamning kasbi yoki kimligini aytishda he/she bilan is ishlatiladi: He is a doctor; She is a teacher. Kasb oldidan birlikdagi a/an qo‘ying. Savolda Is he...? yoki Is she...? deb boshlang; qisqa javob Yes, he is / No, she isn’t.
examples: She’s a nurse. — U hamshira.
Is he a teacher? — No, he isn’t. He’s a driver. — U o‘qituvchimi? — Yo‘q. U haydovchi.
2.2.try: Uchta kasb tanlang. Har biri uchun He’s a... yoki She’s an... jumlasini tuzing; bittasini savol shaklida so‘rang.

2.3.explain: Narsa qayerdaligini so‘rash: Where is...? (bitta), Where are...? (ko‘p). Joy predloglari: in — ichida, on — ustida, under — tagida, next to — yonida. It’s ... birlikka, They’re ... ko‘plikka javob beradi. Soat so‘rashda What time is it? deyiladi.
examples: Where’s the phone? — It’s on the table. — Telefon qayerda? — Stol ustida.
Where are the keys? — They’re in the bag. — Kalitlar qayerda? — Sumkada.
2.3.try: Xonangizdan 3 buyum tanlang va qayerdaligini inglizcha yozing. Bitta buyumni ataylab noto‘g‘ri joylashtirib, sherigingiz topishmoqni yechsin.

2.4.explain: Oddiy savollarda so‘z tartibiga e’tibor bering: What is it? Where are you from? What time is it? Javobda to‘liq gap tuzing. Kichik blogda o‘zingizni tanishtirib, qayerda yashashingiz va kuningiz haqida 3–4 sodda gap yozing.
examples: What time is it? — It’s nine o’clock. — Soat nechada? — Soat to‘qqiz.
I’m Sara. I’m from Tashkent. I’m a student. — Men Sara. Toshkentdanman. O‘quvchiman.
2.4.try: O‘zingiz haqingizda 4 gaplik mini-blog yozing. Sherigingiz matndan What/Where/Who savollarini tuzsin.

3.1.explain: Odam va narsani sifat bilan tasvirlang: sifat ot oldidan keladi — a friendly neighbour. Ko‘plikda sanaladigan otga odatda -s qo‘shiladi: neighbour/neighbours. Sifatning o‘zi ko‘plikka o‘zgarmaydi: friendly neighbours.
examples: He’s a friendly neighbour. — U qo‘shni, xushmuomala.
They’re interesting people. — Ular qiziqarli odamlar.
3.1.try: Bir tanishingizni 3 sifat bilan tasvirlang. Sherigingiz sifatlarni topib, odamni taxmin qilsin.

3.2.explain: Egalikdagi narsalarni have got bilan ayting: I/you/we/they have got; he/she has got. Inkor: haven’t got / hasn’t got. Savol: Have you got...? Qisqa javob: Yes, I have / No, I haven’t. Bu darsda buyumlar, xona va gadjetlarni tasvirlang.
examples: I’ve got a laptop. — Menda noutbuk bor.
Has she got a car? — No, she hasn’t. — Unda mashina bormi? — Yo‘q.
3.2.try: O‘zingizda bor 3 narsa va yo‘q 1 narsa haqida have got bilan gap tuzing.

3.3.explain: Oila a’zolarini ayting va egalikni belgilang: my — mening, his — uning (erkak), her — uning (ayol), our — bizning, their — ularning. Oila daraxtida kim kimga qarindosh ekanini qisqa gap bilan tushuntiring.
examples: This is my sister. Her name is Malika. — Bu singlim. Uning ismi Malika.
Their parents are doctors. — Ularning ota-onasi shifokor.
3.3.try: Oila daraxtingizdan 4 kishini tanlab, my/his/her/our/their bilan tanishtiring.

3.4.explain: Kundalik muloqotda qisqa iboralarni vaziyatga mos ishlating. Fikrlarni and (va) bilan qo‘shing; qarama-qarshi fikr uchun but (lekin) ishlating. Ijtimoiy tarmoq posti uchun salom, 2–3 ma’lumot va yakuniy fikr yozing.
examples: I’ve got a sister and two brothers. — Mening bir opam va ikki ukam bor.
My flat is small but comfortable. — Kvartiram kichkina, lekin qulay.
3.4.try: Uyingiz yoki oilangiz haqida 4 gaplik post yozing; kamida bir marta and va bir marta but ishlating.

4.1.explain: Kundalik odatlar uchun Present Simple ishlatiladi. I/you/we/they bilan fe’l oddiy: I work. He/she bilan ko‘pincha -s qo‘shiladi: She works. Kun tartibini ertalabdan kechgacha ketma-ket ayting.
examples: I get up at seven. — Men soat yettida turaman.
He works in an office. — U ofisda ishlaydi.
4.1.try: Odatdagi kuningizni 5 gapda yozing. Yana bir gapni he yoki she bilan boshqa odam haqida tuzing.

4.2.explain: Odatni inkor qilish uchun I/you/we/they + don’t + fe’l; he/she + doesn’t + fe’l ishlating. Doesn’t dan keyin fe’lga -s qo‘shilmaydi: She doesn’t drive. Transport bilan by bus/by train, piyoda on foot deyiladi.
examples: I don’t drive to work. — Men ishga mashinada bormayman.
She doesn’t go by bus. — U avtobusda bormaydi.
4.2.try: Qanday transportda yurishingiz va nimalar qilmasligingiz haqida 4 gap tuzing; bittasida he/she ishlating.

4.3.explain: Present Simple savolida Do I/you/we/they...? va Does he/she...? deyiladi. Asosiy fe’l savolda ham oddiy shaklda qoladi. Qisqa javob: Yes, I do / No, I don’t; Yes, she does / No, she doesn’t. Vaqt va tez-tezlik so‘zlarini qo‘shing.
examples: What time do you start? — At nine. — Soat nechada boshlaysiz? — To‘qqizda.
Does he work at home? — Yes, he does. — U uydan ishlaydimi? — Ha.
4.3.try: Sherigingizga kun tartibi haqida Do you...? bilan 3 savol bering; u javob bergach javobini qayta ayting.

4.4.explain: Do‘konda muloyim gapiring: Can I help you? (Yordam beraymi?), I’m looking for... (… qidiryapman), How much is it? (Qancha turadi?). Norasmiy emailda Hi + ism bilan boshlang, xabar yozing va See you/Best bilan yakunlang.
examples: I’m looking for a blue shirt. — Men ko‘k ko‘ylak qidiryapman.
How much is it? — It’s twenty pounds. — Qancha? — Yigirma funt.
4.4.try: Sotuvchi va xaridor bo‘lib 5 replikali suhbat tuzing, keyin do‘stga kuningiz haqida qisqa email yozing.

5.1.explain: Kiyim va rangni ayting: a red jacket, black shoes. Tez-tezlik ravishlari odatda asosiy fe’ldan oldin keladi: I usually wear jeans. Be fe’lidan keyin keladi: I’m often late. Kiyim odatingizni har kuni/ba’zan/hech qachon so‘zlari bilan ifodalang.
examples: I usually wear trainers. — Men odatda sport oyoq kiyimi kiyaman.
She is often in black. — U ko‘pincha qora kiyimda bo‘ladi.
5.1.try: Bir haftada qanday kiyim kiyishingizni 4 gapda yozing; usually, sometimes yoki never ishlating.

5.2.explain: Bino haqida oddiy sifatlar bilan fikr bildiring: old/new, big/small, beautiful/modern. Savol so‘zlari bilan aniqlik kiriting: What is it like? Where is it? What colour is it? Sifat ot oldidan keladi: a modern building.
examples: It’s a beautiful old building. — Bu chiroyli eski bino.
Where is it? — It’s in the city centre. — Qayerda? — Shahar markazida.
5.2.try: O‘zingiz bilgan binoni 3 sifat va 2 joylashuv gapi bilan tasvirlang. Sherigingiz qaysi bino ekanini topsin.

5.3.explain: Dunyo bo‘ylab kiyinish uslublarini tasvirlang. Odamlar nima kiyishini aytishda Present Simple: People wear... He/she wears... Tana a’zolari kiyim o‘lchami yoki ko‘rinishini izohlashda kerak: long hair, big eyes. Odatlarni ham frequency adverbs bilan ayting.
examples: People wear light clothes in hot weather. — Issiq havoda odamlar yengil kiyim kiyadi.
He wears a hat. — U shlyapa kiyadi.
5.3.try: Ikki xil kiyinish uslubini taqqoslab, 4 sodda gap tuzing. Rasm bo‘lsa, kiyim rangi va tana a’zosini aytib sherigingizga topdiring.

5.4.explain: Sayohat ma’lumotida manzil, transport va vaqtni aniqlang. Kelishuv uchun What time...? Where...? How...? savollaridan foydalaning. Xabar qisqa bo‘lsin: salomlashish, uchrashuv joyi-vaqti, javob so‘rash va xayrlashish.
examples: What time is the train? — At half past six. — Poyezd soat nechada? — Olti yarimda.
Let’s meet at the station at six. — Keling, bekatda soat oltida uchrashamiz.
5.4.try: Do‘stingiz bilan safar uchrashuvini kelishing: manzil, vaqt va transport haqida 4 xabar yozing.

6.1.explain: Shahar joylarini there is/there are bilan tanishtiring: birlik there is, ko‘plik there are. Inkor: there isn’t/there aren’t. Joylashuv uchun near, next to, opposite (ro‘parasida) ishlating. Xarita chizib, joylarni bir-biriga nisbatan ayting.
examples: There’s a bank next to the café. — Kafe yonida bank bor.
There are two parks near my house. — Uyim yaqinida ikkita park bor.
6.1.try: Mahallangizning kichik xaritasini chizing va there is/are bilan 5 joyni ta’riflang.

6.2.explain: Mehmonxona qulayligini so‘rash uchun Is there a...? (bitta) yoki Are there any...? (ko‘p) deb boshlang. Javob: Yes, there is / No, there isn’t; Yes, there are / No, there aren’t. Resepshnda kerakli qulaylik bor-yo‘qligini tekshiring.
examples: Is there a swimming pool? — Yes, there is. — Basseyn bormi? — Ha.
Are there any lifts? — No, there aren’t. — Liftlar bormi? — Yo‘q.
6.2.try: Mehmonxonani tanlayotgandek 4 savol tuzing: Wi-Fi, nonushta, lift va basseynni so‘rang.

6.3.explain: Xonadagi buyumlarni there is/are va joy predloglari bilan tasvirlang. Each — har biri alohida; all — hammasi birgalikda. Xonada nima borligini, buyum qayerda turganini aniq ayting.
examples: There’s a sofa in the living room. — Mehmonxonada divan bor.
All the rooms have windows. Each room has a bed. — Barcha xonalarda deraza bor. Har bir xonada karavot bor.
6.3.try: Xonangiz rejasini chizing. 5 mebelni there is/are, in/on/next to bilan joylashtirib ta’riflang.

6.4.explain: Mehmonxonadagi muammoni muloyim tushuntiring: There’s a problem with... (…da muammo bor), The ... doesn’t work (… ishlamayapti). Sharhda joy, yaxshi tomoni, muammo va umumiy bahoni yozing.
examples: There’s a problem with the shower. — Dushda muammo bor.
The room was clean, but the Wi-Fi didn’t work. — Xona toza edi, lekin Wi-Fi ishlamadi.
6.4.try: Mehmonxona haqida 5 gapli review yozing: 2 yaxshi jihat, bitta muammo va yakuniy baho.

7.1.explain: Qila olish qobiliyati can + fe’l bilan aytiladi; can dan keyin fe’lga -s yoki to qo‘shilmaydi. Inkor can’t. Savol Can you...? Javob Yes, I can / No, I can’t. Qobiliyatlaringizni aytib, sherigingiznikini so‘rang.
examples: I can swim, but I can’t ski. — Men suza olaman, lekin chang‘i ucha olmayman.
Can she cook? — Yes, she can. — U ovqat pishira oladimi? — Ha.
7.1.try: Qila oladigan 3 ish va hali qila olmaydigan 2 ishni yozing. Sherigingizga Can you...? bilan savol bering.

7.2.explain: Iltimosni Can you...? bilan muloyim so‘rang; Could you...? yanada xushmuomala. Javob: Sure/Of course yoki Sorry, I can’t. Harakat qanday bajarilishini ravish bilan tasvirlang: slowly, quickly, carefully. Sifat + -ly ko‘p hollarda ravish yasaydi.
examples: Can you speak slowly, please? — Sekinroq gapira olasizmi, iltimos?
He drives carefully. — U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
7.2.try: 3 muloyim iltimos yozing va har biriga ijobiy yoki uzrli javob bering. Bir javobda slowly yoki carefully ishlating.

7.3.explain: Yoqtirgan mashg‘ulotni like/love + fe’l-ing bilan ayting: I like reading. Yoqtirmaslik don’t like/hate + -ing: She doesn’t like running. Harakat nomi uchun fe’lga -ing qo‘shiladi; make → making kabi oxirgi e tushadi.
examples: I love taking photos. — Men suratga olishni yaxshi ko‘raman.
He doesn’t like dancing. — U raqs tushishni yoqtirmaydi.
7.3.try: 3 yoqtirgan va 2 yoqtirmagan mashg‘ulot haqida gap yozing. Kamida bir gapni he/she bilan tuzing.

7.4.explain: Hobbi yoki tadbir haqida ijtimoiy tarmoq posti yozing: nima, qayerda, qachon va kim uchun. Do‘stni Would you like to...? yoki Do you want to...? bilan taklif qiling. Javobda I’d love to / Sorry, I can’t ishlating.
examples: Would you like to come to the concert? — Konsertga kelishni xohlaysizmi?
I’d love to! What time? — Jon deb! Soat nechada?
7.4.try: Do‘stingizni klub yoki tadbirga taklif qiladigan 4 replikali chat yozing; taklif va javob bo‘lsin.

8.1.explain: O‘tmishdagi holat va yoshni was/were bilan ayting: I/he/she was; you/we/they were. Inkor wasn’t/weren’t. Savol Was she...? Were they...? Javob Yes, she was / No, they weren’t. Sana aytish uchun oy va tartib sonlarni o‘rganing.
examples: I was born in 2010. — Men 2010-yilda tug‘ilganman.
Were you at home yesterday? — Yes, I was. — Kecha uydamidingiz? — Ha.
8.1.try: Bolaligingiz yoki kechagi kuningiz haqida was/were ishlatib 4 gap yozing; bittasini savol qiling.

8.2.explain: Muntazam fe’l o‘tgan zamonda ko‘pincha -ed oladi: work/worked, play/played. Fe’l -e bilan tugasa faqat -d: live/lived. Kechagi ishlar haqida gapiring. Ayrim yozilish o‘zgarishlarini kitobdagi fe’l jadvalidan tekshiring.
examples: We visited our friends. — Biz do‘stlarimizni ko‘rgani bordik.
She lived in London. — U Londonda yashagan.
8.2.try: Kecha qilgan ishlaringizdan 5 tasini yozing. Muntazam fe’llarga -ed qo‘shib, baland ovozda o‘qing.

8.3.explain: O‘tgan voqeani aytganda takroriy ism o‘rniga object pronoun ishlatiladi: me (meni), him (uni, erkak), her (uni, ayol), us (bizni), them (ularni). Fe’ldan keyin keladi: saw him, called us. Rasm ketma-ketligidan hikoya tuzing.
examples: I saw Anna and called her. — Annani ko‘rdim va unga qo‘ng‘iroq qildim.
They invited us. — Ular bizni taklif qilishdi.
8.3.try: 3 kadrli voqeani tasavvur qilib 4 o‘tgan zamon gap yozing; kamida ikki object pronoun ishlating.

8.4.explain: Biografiyada tug‘ilgan/yashagan/o‘lgan sanalarni tartib bilan ayting. Was born — tug‘ilgan, died — vafot etgan. Tug‘ilgan sana uchun on + sana/yil; joy uchun in + shahar/mamlakat ishlatiladi. Qiziqish bildirish uchun Really? That’s interesting! kabi javob qo‘shing.
examples: She was born in 1995 in Samarkand. — U 1995-yilda Samarqandda tug‘ilgan.
He died in 2020. — U 2020-yilda vafot etgan.
8.4.try: Bir tanilgan inson haqida 5 gapli sodda biografiya yozing: tug‘ilgan yili, joyi, ishi va bitta yutug‘i.

9.1.explain: Ko‘p ishlatiladigan fe’llarning o‘tgan zamoni muntazam emas: go→went, see→saw, have→had, find→found, get→got. Bularni juftlik qilib yodlang. Hikoyada avval nima bo‘lganini ketma-ket ayting.
examples: We went to the market and saw a cat. — Bozorga bordik va mushukni ko‘rdik.
I found my keys. — Kalitlarimni topdim.
9.1.try: went, saw, had va found so‘zlarining barchasini ishlatib, kulgili 4 gapli hikoya yozing.

9.2.explain: O‘tgan zamon savoli Did + ega + fe’lning oddiy shakli bilan yasaladi: Did you go? Inkor didn’t + oddiy fe’l: I didn’t go. Did ishlatilganda went emas, go bo‘ladi. Qisqa javob Yes, I did / No, I didn’t.
examples: Did you see the show? — Yes, I did. — Tomoshani ko‘rdingizmi? — Ha.
She didn’t take a taxi. — U taksi olmadi.
9.2.try: O‘tgan dam olish kuningiz haqida 3 Did...? savol va 3 didn’t javob yozing.

9.3.explain: Ago o‘tgan vaqtni hozirgi paytdan sanaydi: two days ago — ikki kun oldin. Ob-havo haqida It was sunny/rainy/windy deb ayting. Last time savoli oxirgi marta qachon/qayerda bo‘lganini so‘raydi; javobda vaqt, joy va voqeani bog‘lang.
examples: I was there three weeks ago. — Men u yerda uch hafta oldin bo‘lganman.
It was cold, but we played football. — Havo sovuq edi, lekin futbol o‘ynadik.
9.3.try: Oxirgi marta borgan tadbiringizni 4 gapda yozing: qachon, ob-havo qanday, nima qildingiz?

9.4.explain: Tadbir haqidagi review o‘quvchiga nimalar bo‘lganini va sizga yoqqan-yoqmaganini aytadi. Past Simple bilan voqealarni, because bilan sababni yozing. Kuchli his uchun really yoki very qo‘shing. Yakunda baho yoki tavsiya bering.
examples: The concert was great because the music was exciting. — Konsert ajoyib edi, chunki musiqa hayajonli edi.
I really enjoyed it. — Menga juda yoqdi.
9.4.try: Borgan tadbiringizga 1–5 yulduz bering va 5 gapli review yozing: qayerda, qachon, nima bo‘ldi, nima uchun yoqdi.

10.1.explain: Kelajak rejasini be going to bilan ayting: I am going to..., he is going to..., they are going to... Inkor not be going to; savol Am/Is/Are ... going to...? Reja va niyat haqida gapirganda vaqtni ham ayting.
examples: I’m going to start a new course next week. — Keyingi hafta yangi kurs boshlamoqchiman.
Are they going to move? — Yes, they are. — Ular ko‘chmoqchimi? — Ha.
10.1.try: Kelasi haftaga 4 reja yozing. Ulardan birini sherigingizga Are you going to...? savoli bilan so‘rang.

10.2.explain: Yangi joy yoki loyiha haqida reja va taxminlaringizni going to bilan tushuntiring. Savolda be fe’lini egadan oldinga o‘tkazing: What are you going to do? Javobda ish, joy va vaqtni ayting.
examples: What are you going to do in London? — I’m going to study. — Londonda nima qilmoqchisiz? — O‘qimoqchiman.
We’re going to open a small café in June. — Iyun oyida kichik kafe ochmoqchimiz.
10.2.try: Yangi shaharga borish yoki loyiha boshlash haqida 4 savol-javobli intervyu yozing.
vocab: What are you going to do?

10.3.explain: Kafe yoki restoranda xushmuomala buyurtma berish uchun I’d like... (= I would like, men ... xohlayman) ishlating. Savol: What would you like? Ichimlik yoki taom so‘rash: Can I have...? Buyurtmani tekshirib, please va thank you qo‘shing.
examples: I’d like a coffee, please. — Menga qahva bering, iltimos.
Would you like anything to eat? — Yes, a sandwich, please. — Yegulik xohlaysizmi? — Ha, sendvich, iltimos.
10.3.try: Menyudan taom tanlab, ofitsiant va mijoz rolida 6 replikali buyurtma dialogi tuzing.

10.4.explain: Taklif xatida nima, qayerda va qachon bo‘lishini aniq yozing. Would you like to...? bilan taklif qiling. Rahmat xatida Thank you for... deb sababni ayting; taklifdan keyin javob yoki keyingi qadamni bildiring.
examples: Would you like to come to dinner on Friday? — Juma kuni kechki ovqatga kelishni xohlaysizmi?
Thank you for the invitation. I’d love to come. — Taklif uchun rahmat. Jon deb boraman.
10.4.try: Do‘stingizni tadbirga taklif qiluvchi xabar va taklif uchun rahmat bildiruvchi javob yozing.
